facts.raw_span: episodes of spasms and tremors in her right hand and forearm
underwent carpal tunnel release surgery initially
tremors recurred
progressive right-sided weakness, dysarthria, hand tremors, slurred speech, and gait instability
No specific physical examination findings were reported in the case

T2-weighted fluid-attenuated inversion recovery MRI showed hyperintensities throughout the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter, corpus callosum, basal ganglia, thalami, midbrain, upper pons, and middle cerebellar peduncles
T1-weighted fluid-attenuated inversion recovery MRI with contrast showed absence of contrast enhancement
Brain Biopsy (left frontal lesion): CD5− CD10− CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER−
Cytogenetic study: Normal female karyotype
Fluorescence in situ hybridization: Extra copies of BCL6 (3q27) and BCL2 (18q21), no MYC abnormalities
Cerebrospinal fluid: Presence of lymphoma cells
Bone marrow: Negative for lymphoma cells

concepts.why: The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy results support this diagnosis
The MRI findings of hyperintensities in the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter are consistent with this diagnosis
The progressive right-sided weakness, dysarthria, hand tremors, and gait instability are consistent with this diagnosis
The MRI findings of hyperintensities in the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter are consistent with this diagnosis
The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy results, along with the negative bone marrow test, support the diagnosis of Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma.

rationales.F06: Bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter hyperintensities are more typical of Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma and Multiple Sclerosis.
rationales.F08: Brain biopsy showing CD19+ CD20+ B cells is diagnostic of lymphoma.
rationales.F10: Extra copies of BCL6 and BCL2 are commonly found in lymphomas.
rationales.F11: Presence of lymphoma cells in cerebrospinal fluid is diagnostic of Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma.

frontier_selector.rationale: Brain biopsy and cerebrospinal fluid analysis showing presence of lymphoma cells, along with specific immunophenotyping and genetic findings, strongly support this diagnosis.
